Giao diện mặc định áp dụng cho trang đăn: The default appearance applies to the sign-in page and to every user who has not chosen their own. Changes are previewed on this page right away and only take effect after saving.
Bỏ chọn để tự chỉnh giao diện riêng – ch: Turn off to customize your own appearance – it applies only to your account, on every device. Changes are previewed on this page right away and only take effect after saving.
Áp dụng cho nút bấm, liên kết, biểu tượn: Used for buttons, links, icons, charts, the selected menu item… Lighter and darker shades are derived from the primary color automatically.
Phông có nhãn “web” tải từ Google Fonts: Fonts labeled “web” are loaded from Google Fonts (Internet required); when offline the browser falls back to a font installed on the computer.
Menu trên / dưới hiển thị theo nhóm, rê: A top / bottom menu shows one entry per group – hover or click a group to open it. On phones and narrow screens the menu always slides out from the ☰ button.
